title: US Companies Added Fewer Jobs Than Expected in July: ADP
summary: US private payrolls rose 44,000 in July after a revised 95,000 increase in the prior month as companies added fewer jobs than expected, according to ADP Research data out Wednesday. Michael McKee reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
